note: Boat-ramp access on the Fabius River, a few miles above the Mississippi. Camping is on the gravel strip that leads to the ramp, which MDC marks as a primitive camping area; the river is about 30 m away behind a band of trees. No pads, tables or toilets. The area floods. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: one gravel strip and ramp lot at the end of County Road 344, with MDC's Primitive Camping Area symbol on the map and one GIS camping point on it - stays under the Lick Creek reading of the lot rule, flagged for the owner. Pin on the camping point. Phone matches. Page warns the area is subject to flooding.
flags: LOT RULE - STAYS, OWNER TO CONFIRM: the page lists 'Designated Camping Sites' (and walk-in/float camping outside deer and turkey seasons); the 06/08 map puts a Primitive Camping Area symbol immediately west of the single Parking Lot square and Boat Ramp; GIS layer 27 has one point, 199 'Primitive Camping Area', at 39.88885,-91.48825, 58 m west of lot 1355 (39.88887,-91.48757). On imagery it is one continuous gravel strip about 110 m long and 8-15 m wide where the county road ends at the concrete ramp; the camping point is on its west half, the ramp at its east end. Nothing but gravel: no pads, rings or tables visible. A designated point at the lot keeps it (as Lick Creek); if a ramp lot with nothing else is a drop even with the symbol, this is one.
FLOODING: the page carries 'This area is subject to flooding. Check local conditions, and do not drive onto flooded roadways.' Put in the note. No current closure is posted.

WATERFRONT (no change, not waterfront): the gravel strip runs parallel to the Fabius River 25-35 m from the bank, but a continuous band of mature trees stands between it and the water for its whole length except the ramp cut itself (leaf-on frame). No open apron; the only water sightline is down the ramp. The water is the Fabius River (page: 'offers access to the Fabius River'); the Mississippi is about 3 km east.
PIN: stored 39.88885,-91.48825 is the GIS camping point, on the gravel. No move.
ACCESS: County Road 344 (gravel) to the lot; no posted limit or 4WD wording on the page or map.
PHONE: stored 573-248-2530 matches the page's 'For more information call (573) 248-2530'.
